mapper.select: SELECT member_id, monthly_income, monthly_living_cost, monthly_remittance, current_savings, updated_at FROM financial_info WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO financial_info (member_id, monthly_income, monthly_living_cost, monthly_remittance, current_savings) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{monthlyIncome}, #{monthlyLivingCost}, #{monthlyRemittance}, #{currentSavings}) AS newrow ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE monthly_income = newrow.monthly_income, monthly_living_cost = newrow.monthly_living_cost, monthly_remittance = newrow.monthly_remittance, current_savings = newrow.current_savings
